message.content:
I see the issue. In the `check_is_padded(Opts)` version (the first one, used when `null_terminated = false`), the code does `std::memcpy(&chunk, it, 8)` without checking if there are at least 8 bytes remaining. This reads 8 bytes even when fewer are available, causing a heap-buffer-overflow READ.
